# Robin Farrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Seven years old  <sub>[v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031), [v2 c10 P44](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0044)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive
- **Origin:** East Welby  <sub>[v2 c1 P30](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0030), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Mr. Robin Farrow  <sub>[v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Robin has a round skull covered with tiny, fuzzy yellow ringlets, a snub nose, and lively hazel eyes. His mouth is perpetually smiling, featuring a single dimple on one cheek that gives him a sweet and amusingly uneven expression when he laughs. He is stocky and short, with plump arms and legs.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c15 P37](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0037), [v2 c26 P4](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0004)_

## Personality

Robin possesses a mischievous, energetic, and inquisitive nature, constantly seeking out excitement and play. Though prone to practical jokes and impish misbehavior, he is deeply affectionate, frank, and eager to win approval. He struggles with staying still or resisting tempting treats, but shows a fierce protective instinct toward his twin sister.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000), [v2 c8 P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c10 P43](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0043), [v2 c10 P52](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0052)_

- To grow as tall as Cedric Stanhope  <sub>[v2 c26 P4](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0004)</sub>

## History

Following the death of his invalid mother in East Welby, six-year-old Robin and his twin sister Lucy were taken to Grey Shutters by Thirza Abernethy. His lively and disruptive presence immediately created a contrast with his quiet sister. On his first Sunday, he dropped a caterpillar down a girl's collar during church services, causing a grand commotion. He frequently got into trouble by climbing onto tables, drenching Lucy under the pump, and trapping her in Mr. Pettifer's toolhouse for amusement. After being reprimanded for lying about Lucy's whereabouts, he sincerely promised Nell never to tell another untruth. Robin started attending Brierley school under Nell Harcourt, forming a rivalry and friendship with his classmate Milty Gammon. When Thirza考虑 selling Grey Shutters, the twins were able to remain permanently after their late uncle left a trust fund for their care.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P30](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0030), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000), [v2 c8 P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 c8 P47](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0047), [v2 c10 P36](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0036), [v2 c10 P53](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0053), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022)_

## Background by volume

- Born six minutes after his twin sister, Lucy Farrow, in East Welby  <sub>[v2 c1 P30](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0030), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000)</sub>
- Lost his father shortly after birth and was raised by his ill mother, Mary Farrow  <sub>[v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031)</sub>
- Taken in by his third cousin, Thirza Abernethy, at Grey Shutters following his mother's death  <sub>[v2 c7 P27](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0027), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000)</sub>
